target_semantics_note: The meaning of FraudFound_P is undocumented. Models predict only that recorded label; they do not establish confirmed or real-world fraud detection.

routing_field.use: select specialist only; excluded from every pipeline input

full.rationale: Reference group: every configured input, with VehicleCategory reserved for routing.

no_claim_timing.rationale: Removes the claim-timing fields whose availability at prediction time is unverified.

no_calendar.rationale: Removes calendar fields to test whether the remaining policy and incident inputs hold up without them.

threshold_rule: For each candidate, validation-only maximum F1 for the positive label; highest threshold breaks F1 ties.
ranking_rule: Within each vehicle category, highest validation average precision; validation F1 breaks a tie.
preprocessing_and_fit_partition: Each candidate preprocessing pipeline and classifier fit only on that category's training rows.
feature_timing_note: Timing and availability of every feature are unverified; candidate reduction is not a claim of screening-time availability.

minimum_example_floor.note: A modest run-safety floor only; passing it does not imply statistical reliability.

Sport.reason: Below the floor of 100 training or 30 validation examples per class.
